packageRules.description: npm minor updates wait 7 days after release (patch keeps the 3-day preset; security updates are never delayed).
npm major updates wait 14 days after release.
GitHub Actions release updates wait 7 days; digests/pins have no release timestamp so they are exempt.

gh-aw lock files are compiled artifacts: `gh aw compile` regenerates them and overwrites hand edits, and runtime pins such as node-version belong to the pinned gh-aw release. Upgrade them only through a gh-aw upgrade (see docs/agentic-pipeline.md), never via Renovate.
